summary: Fresh build validation of Munsiji.app — end-to-end backend + mobile UI testing. 24/24 pytest backend tests passed (auth, groups, ledger CRUD, txn recalc, statement running balance, merge, exports for pdf/excel/csv served publicly with send_whatsapp=true via mock provider, dashboard, monthly summary, settings, PIN change, AI whatsapp simulate flow with new party creation → fuzzy match → credit → 'ledger bhej' clarify → pdf export files[], last-entry delete, webhook processed+dedupe+non-whitelist ignored, wa messages/status). 100% mobile UI flows passed on 390x844 viewport: PIN screen, wrong PIN error 'Galat PIN', login with 3366 → home dashboard with 5 default group cards + total lena/dena, tap group → ledgers list, add ledger FAB+sheet+save persists row, tap ledger → statement screen with month chips, add manual entry sheet opens, export sheet generates and shows download link, ledger menu (rename/move/merge/delete) opens, whatsapp screen send received bot reply, summary screen, settings screen, logout returns to PIN. Only minor non-blocking react-native-web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents).

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' — surfaced on hero cards / sheets on web. Not a runtime error; migrate for future RN Web compat.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents — reported on web preview; migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required — all requested backend & frontend flows verified working.

Webhook path handles whitelist + wa_message_id dedupe via db.wa_messages index — behavior confirmed.
